caption: day in the life of a cybersecurity analyst 🔐 (it's not what movies show)
transcript_snippet: 8am: review overnight SIEM alerts — 400 of them, 398 are false positives. 10am: write an incident report no one will read. 3pm: someone clicked a phishing link. Again. 5pm: patch Tuesday broke production.

caption: honest review: 6 months at a coding bootcamp — was it worth it? 👨‍💻
transcript_snippet: Week 1: JavaScript fundamentals, felt like a genius. Week 8: Node, Express, databases — barely sleeping. Month 5: built my first full-stack app. Month 6: job hunting. Verdict: hard, humbling, and actually worth it if you put in the hours.

caption: this Elden Ring boss took me 47 attempts and i have ZERO regrets 🗡️💀
transcript_snippet: Attempt 1 through 46: humiliation. Attempt 47: I don't know what happened, my hands just moved on their own. Malenia down. I cried. Not ashamed.
